## Source Code Access Request

Thank you for your interest in the AI Restaurant Assistant project!

The complete source code is maintained in a private GitHub repository. Access requests are reviewed individually.

### Requester Information

**GitHub Username:**  
@your-username

**Professional Role:**  
Recruiter / Hiring Manager / AI Engineer / Software Engineer / Other

**Organization (Optional):**  
Company or organization name

**Purpose of Access:**  
Briefly explain why you would like to review the source code.

### Access Guidelines

- Access is granted at the repository owner's discretion.
- Approved applicants receive a private GitHub repository invitation.
- Please do not redistribute or publish the source code without permission.
- Access may be revoked after the review period.

**Privacy:** This issue will be publicly visible. Do not include personal contact details or confidential information.

Thank you for your interest!
